title: Apply a settings document to a PIM Manager environment (settings as code)
purpose: Applies a settings document (written by Export-PimSettings.ps1, or kept in source control) to a named PIM Manager environment's store: it shows the plan per setting (add / change / same), backs up what it would replace, and only with -Apply writes each setting and reads it back. A second -Apply changes nothing.
whenToRun: When an environment should be set to settings kept as code -- a new environment baselined from a known-good one, or a reviewed change to settings applied by an operator or a pipeline. A document that carries a secret, or a setting that names an environment itself (who may use it, approvers, break-glass accounts, demo mode, environment name, licence and install keys, rings, the scenario, runtime state), is refused as a whole; so is a document from a newer format version.

runAs.name: Store writer (application with a certificate, member of the target SQL admin group)
runAs.why: Reads the target's current values and, with -Apply, writes the document's values. Given with -ClientId / -CertThumbprint; the certificate must be in the local machine certificate store.

changes.object: pim.Settings row for each setting of the document that is added or changed (one JSON document per setting)
changes.why: The point of the script: the target gets the document's value (with -MergeKeys, the document's top-level keys plus the keys only the target has). Settings the document does not name are not touched; nothing is deleted.
changes.undo: Import the TARGET-BEFORE backup file the run wrote (Import-PimSettings.ps1 -Path <backup> -Apply); a setting the import added is listed in it as addedByImport.

changes.why: The target's values before any change, as a settings document, so they can be restored; taken on every run that would change something, also a plan run.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.help: Apply only these settings of the document. Default: all of them.

parameters.name: ClientId
parameters.help: Application (client) id of the identity that writes the target store.

parameters.name: CertThumbprint
parameters.help: Thumbprint of that identity's certificate in the local machine store.

parameters.name: EnvironmentName
parameters.help: The target environment's name; when given, a store with a different environment name is refused.

parameters.name: BackupDir
parameters.help: Where the target's current values are written before anything changes.

parameters.name: MergeKeys
parameters.help: For an object setting: keep the top-level keys only the target has (the document's keys win). Arrays and plain values are replaced whole.

parameters.name: Apply
parameters.help: Write. Without it the script only shows the plan.

readsOnly: pim.Settings in the target store (the document's settings and the environment name, before and after the write)
network: login.microsoftonline.com (tokens for Azure SQL, certificate sign-in)
whatIf: Reads the document and the target store, prints the plan (add / change / same per setting) and 'What if: Performing the operation "<add|change> from the settings document" on target "pim.Settings['<Name>'] in <server>/<database> (tenant <id>)"'. Nothing is written to the store; a backup in the temp folder is still taken, a backup elsewhere is only announced.
undo: Import the TARGET-BEFORE backup file with -Apply (it restores the values that were replaced). The local backup can be deleted.
